temp_gate.note: same gate as the CPU protocol: GPU campaigns on passively cooled hosts throttle too. Hosts without the sensor path skip this gate.

apple_m1max_metal.note: M1 Max 32-core GPU, unified memory. Same host as apple_m1max in the CPU protocol; the GPU cell and the CPU cell describe the same machine under two backends. Thread counts are dispatch-side only.

nvidia_2080ti_vulkan.note: RTX 2080 Ti 11 GB (Turing) in the 9950X box; same host as amd_9950x in the CPU protocol, different backend column. The host also enumerates a Raphael iGPU — runs must set GGML_VK_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 so llama.cpp binds the discrete device; geist's vk_pick_device prefers discrete on its own. Thread counts are dispatch-side only, matching apple_m1max_metal.

workload.affinity: thread-count-only; operating-system scheduled for both engines
workload.kv_cache: f16, resident on the GPU for both engines
workload.thread_policy: per host_profile; identical for both engines within a run. On a fully offloaded run CPU threads only drive dispatch and sampling; they are fixed anyway so a cell states its whole configuration.
workload.warmup: one discarded engine-native warmup before each measured test
